description:
For weeks, a mysterious man has been setting Gyeol’s dreams on fire. By day, Gyeol lives a quiet life as a construction worker. But after locking eyes with a stranger at a job site, his nights are consumed by vivid, erotic dreams that leave him shaken - and wanting more. When he unexpectedly runs into the man again, reality begins to feel just as charged as his fantasies. The stranger introduces himself as Ye-Sung: handsome, magnetic, and impossible to read. His smile is too perfect, his gaze to knowing. He crosses lines without hesitation, drawing Gyeol into a game with no clear rules. As tension smolders between them, Gyeol finds himself spiraling deeper into Ye-Sung’s world, unable to tell where desire ends and danger begins. But play with fire too long, and one is bound to get burned.

(Source: Lezhin US)
